geometry.locator: Letter of Intent for KM3NeT 2.0 (arXiv:1601.07459): 'the average horizontal spacing between detection strings is about 95 m' (ARCA) and 'about 20 m' (ORCA); Figure 15 caption 'R=500 m' (ARCA)
geometry.note: 12-vertex geodesic circle approximation, radius 105 m computed on R=6371008.8 m from the centre (6.0333000, 42.8000000).
geometry.quote: For the ARCA configuration, the average horizontal spacing between detection strings is about 95 m ... For the ORCA configuration, the average horizontal spacing between detection strings is about 20 m.

method: A ~105 m radius circle centred on the surveyed ORCA site coordinate (geometry:km3net-orca-site-point). No fetched source this session states ORCA's own footprint radius directly (unlike ARCA's Letter-of-Intent Figure 15, which gives R=500 m explicitly); this radius is instead MY OWN computation, scaling ARCA's sourced R=500 m by the ratio of the two building blocks' sourced average horizontal detection-unit spacing, both given in the same Letter of Intent (arXiv:1601.07459): 'the average horizontal spacing between detection strings is about 95 m' for ARCA and 'about 20 m' for ORCA. 500 m * (20/95) = ~105 m, on the assumption that ARCA and ORCA use the same 115-string layout pattern at different scale (both are stated to be one 115-detection-unit building block). This is a two-input derived estimate, not a published figure: treat the circle as illustrative of relative scale, not a survey. accuracy_m is set to 2000 m to match the coarser accuracy of the anchor point (the site's own arc-minute-precision coordinate), which dominates over the footprint-radius uncertainty in any case.
name: KM3NeT/ORCA building-block footprint (derived circle)
notes: No checks[] row: no independently-published ORCA footprint figure was found this session to check this estimate against (three fetched papers -- arXiv:2408.07015, arXiv:1701.05849, and the km3net.org ARCA-and-ORCA detector page -- give string spacing but not an overall radius/diameter for ORCA). Web-search summaries suggested a ~100 m radius / ~200 m diameter figure consistent with this estimate, but no primary source stating it could be directly fetched and quoted this session, so it is not cited as a source or used as a checks[] row.

summary.plain: A schematic circle showing the roughly 200 m design width of the KM3NeT/ORCA building block, estimated by scaling ARCA's sourced footprint by the two detectors' relative string spacing; not itself a published measurement.
